children: Brings extensive experience in construction, project management, operations, quality, safety and regional business leadership

Rakesh Kumar Singh has been elevated to Chief Executive Officer at Capacit'e Infraprojects, marking a new leadership role after an extensive career across construction, infrastructure and project management. Singh has previously held senior positions at Capacit'e Infraprojects and other major engineering and construction organisations.

Before his elevation, Singh served as President and Regional Head – North at Capacit'e Infraprojects. His experience at the organisation has included regional leadership and operational responsibilities across the construction business.
His elevation follows a career spanning project execution, operations, construction management and business leadership across the infrastructure sector.

Prior to joining Capacit'e Infraprojects, Singh held senior operational roles at B L Kashyap & Sons, including Senior Vice President Operations and Regional Head, as well as Vice President Operations.
He also served as Head of Operations at Shapoorji Pallonji Group, adding experience in managing construction and operational functions.

Singh's earlier career includes roles at JMC Projects (India), where he served as Assistant Vice President – Operations and Senior General Manager. He was also Deputy General Manager at Tata Projects and General Manager at CBRE.
Earlier assignments included Project Manager and Assistant Construction Manager roles at L&T Construction, followed by an engineering position at Consulting Engineering Services.

Across these roles, Singh has worked across project management, construction, operations, quality and safety. His career has covered different stages of project execution and regional operations within the construction and infrastructure sectors.

As CEO, Singh will take on broader leadership responsibilities at Capacit'e Infraprojects, building on his previous experience with the organisation and his wider background in construction and project operations.
